# pi-glance 0.6.6

## Fixes

- Bash input (`!` and `!!`, including leading whitespace) now uses Pi's Bash-mode border color. Normal prompts, titles, and status segments keep the selected Glance palette. Fixes [#6](https://github.com/LinYS77/pi-glance/issues/6).
- Context warning colors now work in tokens-only display. Thresholds use Pi's reported percentage rather than the rounded value shown in the status line.
- Fixed a crash when displaying Chinese text or emoji in extremely narrow editor frames.

## Internal changes

- Separated configuration validation from file storage, and Git status parsing from process execution.
- Simplified settings navigation state and shared display-option handling.
- Grouped source files under `src/` and tests under `tests/`. The extension entry remains `index.ts`.
- Updated tests for module dependencies and package contents, and shared the CI checks with the release workflow.

## Compatibility

- Tested with Pi 0.84.4.
- Requires Node.js 22.19.0 or newer.
- Config schema remains v8; existing configuration files need no changes.
- No new runtime dependencies.

## Upgrade

```bash
pi update npm:pi-glance
```

Then run `/reload` in Pi.
